Fix the open reliability work: sensor memory ceilings and OOM visibility, ClickHouse cost and capacity, and the health of Postgres, PGMQ and Temporal. Observability and SLOs: symptom-based alerting with Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry, and the discipline to delete noisy alerts. Security-minded operations: least privilege, secrets handling, access reviews and audit trails. You own production and the platform underneath it, with direct contact with the engineers and a say in how we build. Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it. Our infrastructure is defined as code, but parts of it are still being moved into CI, runbooks are thin, and some environments are rougher than others. You would inherit something that works, not something polished. If you want a mature platform team with a clear roadmap for the next two years, this is not it. If you want to build the operational backbone of a security product from close to the start, and you like the idea of running the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.
